english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for domestic chores such as cleaning and cooking.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for domestic chores and housework.
Use this for the work and chores involved in running a home.

examples.english: I did a lot of housework today.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 mou6

examples.english: Domesticity takes up my evenings after work.
examples.traditional: 放工返到屋企，我仲要做家務。
examples.jyutping: fong3 gung1 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 ngo5 zung6 jiu3 zou6 gaa1 mou6

examples.english: I do household chores as soon as I get home.
examples.traditional: 我放工返屋企就做家務。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 faan1 uk1 kei2 zau6 zou6 gaa1 mou6
